t: This is Tufnell Park tube station, in Islington, close to the boundary with Camden. It's on the High Barnet branch of the Northern line, between Archway and Kentish Town, in fare zone 2. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for the Underground stations he created in the first decade of the twentieth century. Look for the oxblood red faïence blocks, the pillars, and the semi-circular windows on the first floor, all part of his distinctive Modern Style.
